members.name: AR-101.exe
members.expected_disposition: extension not in the folder-upload allowed set and not in the version-file allowed set

members.name: AR-101.pdf
members.expected_ingest_disposition: classified as the single project PDF, so the precheck pdf count is one and no no_pdf block is appended

members.name: AR-101_result.json
members.expected_ingest_disposition: accepted: the member is classified by its lowercased filename suffix only and its body is never parsed at ingest, so the bytes are stored verbatim, has_result is true, and the malformed body contributes no block and no warning, because the closed precheck error-code set contains no JSON-validity code

cases.parse_failure_surfaces_at: the downstream crop_blocks stage, not at ingest

pdf_member_is_required_for_this_case.reason: The case isolates the malformed recognized-JSON companion, so it must not also trip the missing-PDF rule. A folder holding the companion alone has a pdf count of zero: precheck appends the no_pdf block, no_pdf is a member of the closed precheck error-code set, and the verdict becomes error; the save path refuses the same folder outright with the no-PDF UploadFolderError. Either outcome would be produced by the absent PDF and not by the malformed JSON.

cases.expected_precheck_verdict: The verdict is whatever the same folder with a well-formed companion would receive: the malformed body raises no code of its own. It is not asserted to be ready unconditionally, because the duplicate, name and object codes still apply to the folder as a whole.

members.name: AR-101.result.json
members.expected_ingest_disposition: collected under ignored_files: the extension is allowed but the lowercased name ends in neither _result.json nor _blocks.json, so the member is dropped from the bundle without a block and without a warning

cases.note: A dot before result is not the legacy companion suffix. The legacy test is a lowercased endswith on _result.json.

note: Every case is a declarative scenario description; no executable payload and no real filesystem path is committed. Member names use the exact legacy companion suffixes so that a golden run exercises the real recognition rule.
